answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond tied to a verifiable work history before it can trade. Creating one fake identity then costs real capital, and a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds, so Sybil scale becomes unaffordable. Misbehavior slashes the bond, so fakes cannot profit and vanish. A reputation badge without collateral is a relic of trust, not trust itself — like yarrow sold as medicine or saffron sold as gold, a claim is only worth something when a bond backs it.
